name: Razorbeak

facts.text: Razorbeak: level 55, model 765 (the fearann wyvern body: fearann wyvern hatchlings 45-50 and ancients 48-50), size 163, at about 399,500/170,300 in the far north-east of Allta Fearann; respawn 80 seconds; a plain spawn.
Living Server lore: Razorbeak as the mother-wyvern of the northern cliffs whose beak the Necht Sylvan use for their oldest oath.

story:
Allta Fearann, the wild land, is the high country north of Vigilant Rock where the forest gives out into scrub and stone and the wind never stops. The mantids hold the ground, and the sky belongs to the things that nest on the crags: skimmers and mantas that ride the updraughts, the fearann wyverns of the northern cliffs, the long-legged waterstrider birds of the high pools. The Sylvan of Necht keep a custom for travellers going north: name the four great ones of the wild land before you go, so that they know you know them. Windskimmer, Goldenleaf, Razorbeak, and the bird the Sylvan call by a name they say came over the sea with the mist.

Razorbeak is the third, and the one the Sylvan of Necht are most careful to name properly. She is the eldest of the fearann wyverns, the lean grey wyverns of the north-eastern cliffs, and she is larger than any of them by half again. The wyvern ancients of the cliffs, who are old enough, are her children; the hatchlings in the cliff nests are their children. She has nested on the same ledge over the northern sea for as long as the Sylvan have records of the north, and her beak, which the Sylvan say is the colour of a new blade, has a notch in it that every Necht child can draw.

The notch is the oldest story of the wild land. A Sylvan of Necht, the story says, in the first generations, climbed the north-eastern cliffs to take a wyvern egg, because a wyvern raised from the egg would carry a rider; and Razorbeak came back to the ledge as he reached the nest, and he struck at her with a bronze knife and broke a piece off her beak, and she let him go. Nobody knows why. The Sylvan who tell it say she let him go because he had faced her and not run. The mantids, who also tell it, say she let him go because the piece of beak was worth more to her than he was, and she went back for it later.

Whichever is true, the Sylvan of Necht swear their oldest oath on the notch, the one a Necht warden takes on the day she is named: may I face what I must, as the egg-thief faced the mother. Hibernian companies who go north after Razorbeak are told the story at Necht before they leave. The ones who come back say they understood it better on the ledge.
legend: Razorbeak is a level 55 fearann wyvern of great size (163) on the north-eastern cliffs of Allta Fearann (about 400k/170k). Plain mob, no script, 80-second respawn. The wyvern ancients and hatchlings (45-50) nest along the same cliffs, so clear the ledges as you go or they will join in. A 50s group with a solid tank handles her. The Necht wardens swear their oldest oath on the notch in her beak: may I face what I must. She drops off her ledge to meet you, so pull from below the cliff, not along it, and keep healers off the narrow ledges where a fall would hurt. Count her as one of the four great ones of the wild land.
